articles.summary: NEW YORK – [May 20, 2026] – Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) today announced the launch of Marc Jacobs Beauty, the color cosmetics collection long anticipated by the brand’s loyal following.
articles.title: Coty Launches Marc Jacobs Beauty: One Of The Most-requested Luxury Comebacks

articles.summary: NEW YORK - May 5, 2026-- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) ("Coty" or "the Company") today announced its results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: COTY ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS

articles.summary: New York, May 4, 2026 -- Coty, one of the world's largest beauty companies, and Pencil, the world's #1 generative AI marketing platform, today announced a partnership to put real-time, AI-powered content creation at the heart of Coty's Consumer Beauty division.
articles.title: Coty partners with Pencil to build end-to-end Gen AI content system

articles.summary: NEW YORK – May 13, 2026 – Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY), (“Coty” or “the Company”) one of the world's largest beauty companies, today announced that its enterprise AI literacy program, "Supercharge with AI: Scaling Enterprise-Wide AI Literacy & Adoption to Transform How Coty Works," (Supercharge with AI), has been named a winner of Newsweek’s AI Impact Award in the “AI Workplace: Best Outcomes, Employee Engagement” category.
articles.title: Coty "Supercharge with AI" Enterprise Upskilling Program Wins Newsweek AI Impact Award
